description: This file contains unit tests for the SessionManagementServer component, verifying its initialization, connection handling, disconnection, and log level settings. It includes test fixtures and uses external system headers.

methods.name: shouldInitializeServer
methods.description: Test that the server initializes successfully.

methods.name: shouldFailToInitializeServer
methods.description: Test that server initialization failure is handled correctly.

methods.name: shouldStartServer
methods.description: Test that the server starts properly.

methods.name: shouldEstablishConnection
methods.description: Test that a client can establish a connection to the server.

methods.name: shouldDisconnectFromClient
methods.description: Test that the server correctly handles client disconnection.

methods.name: shouldSetLogLevels
methods.description: Test that log levels can be set on the server.
